headline: Quiet day as the Five Eyes jolt settles
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Lines barely moved after yesterday's Five Eyes warning; Self-Destruction and Reversion slipped by a few hundredths as earlier stories faded. The darker reading set on June 22 stays largely in place. Horizon Balance held at +0.85.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Self-Destruction and Reversion shifted most, by a few hundredths, from fading contributions.
